title: Minimum sign mass bounds leaf error
statement: Let $Ω$ be a finite set with probability distribution $π$, and let $f:(Ω)^nto br$ take only the values $-1$ and $1$. For any real leaf label $v$, the smaller of the probabilities that $f$ equals $1$ and that $f$ equals $-1$ is at most the probability that the constant-output tree with label $v$ disagrees with $f$.
hypotheses_covered: π is a probability distribution on Ω
v is a real leaf label
f is a real-valued function on Ωⁿ
f takes only the values −1 and 1
